Bill.BriefDescription: Requiring reporting of felony-level complaints against a physician.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to reporting of felony complaints againstphysicians; and adding a new section to chapter 18.71 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 18.71 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: A criminal justice agency, as defined by RCW 10.97.030, shall senda complete report to the commission of any record of arrest, charge, orallegation of criminal conduct possessed by the agency regarding aphysician that would constitute a felony offense under chapter 9.94ARCW.
